author: PC Gamer
text:
That 007 First Light theme song I didn't like is up for a Grammy Award
Well, there's no accounting for taste.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Gabe Newell stuns superyacht enthusiasts by treating crew like human beings: 'That is something we've never really seen before in our industry'
The crew retention on Newell's boats is six times the average on other superyachts.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Trump supports Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO, but it doesn't sound like the board is interested
The US president doesn't seem too concerned about the potential risks to US national security: "I think he learned a big lesson, I guess."

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 6 online rumors: When might the inevitable multiplayer launch happen?
Despite no official word on the subject, we aren't buying that there's no GTA 6 online.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Grand Theft Auto 6 hacker pleads guilty to all charges
Arion Kurtaj released dozens of GTA 6 videos to the public more than a year before the game was formally revealed.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I installed a GTA 5 drag racing mod that got derailed by my roving band of hitmen mod
We've all been there.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Someone hijacked old Bitly links to redirect big brands to Skibidi Toilet and the Epstein files wiki
Even Steven from Mewgenics gets a shout out.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Final Fantasy 14's ongoing pursuit in making its 500-hour story less daunting almost manifested into something in August, but Yoshi-P decided to postpone it
We'll get there… one day.

author: PC Gamer
text:
We almost got a medieval Call of Duty with knights and swords: 'If it's a war story, sure, it can be Call of Duty'
Instead we just got more guns.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Biostar announces the first Intel Panther Lake motherboard and it's tiny, but don't get your hopes up for cramming it into a mini gaming PC
A mini PC with Intel's G3 chip would rock, but alas, we're left with just four Xe3 cores instead.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Final Fantasy 14 really wants Evercold to be the expansion everyone comes back to, so much so it's giving you 30 days free gametime if you've been gone long enough
Time to finish up that post-Dawntrail MSQ, folks.

author: PC Gamer
text:
World of Warcraft: Forever player turns their paladin into a near-unkillable healbot, solos a level 60 monster at level 30, and swims into the ocean
It took 20 minutes, though.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Ashes of the Singularity 2 review: Some neat ideas undermined by a rubbish campaign and obtrusive generative AI
Ashes of the Singularity 2 delivers on gigantic battles, but not much else.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'Game dev isn't always straightforward': Overwatch's director responds to players upset about season 6's hero being a DPS
We don't need any more supports right now.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Intel hit with class action alleging it 'misled investors' – company's recent downturn due in part to how darn expensive PCs are right now
The company saw a large stock price decline just last week.

author: PC Gamer
text:
New Asus beta BIOS patches now include a fresh AMD feature to stop you thinking your PC's b0rked
The new memory training counter shows your PC hasn't just hung on boot.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Jensen Huang reportedly eyeing up return to Nvidia as friendly tech execs form 'war room' to fight for him and over 175,000 people sign #bringjensenback petition
This one might have to wait until after Huang's meetings in Congress.

author: PC Gamer
text:
WoW: Forever's continued to wrestle with dungeons, as Blizzard admits it briefly 'missed the mark' on hotfixes over the weekend
Out on the level range.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The latest SteamOS update improves support on Nvidia-powered PCs: makes swapping your rig to the OS less painful
And a custom rig will be better priced than the Steam Machine.

author: PC Gamer
text:

Morrison retired just six months ago.
